messages:
sara_marketing: Quick sync — launch briefing plan for Redwood Inference v2.0. We have an embargo window: 2026-03-25 08:00 PT. Need final quotes and fact-check signoff by EOD 2026-03-24. Link to press packet: https://redwood.box.com/s/launch-packet-2.0 :wave:

james_pr: Thanks. Can we do two analyst sessions to cover US/EU? Suggested times: 03/25 09:00 PT (US) and 03/25 16:00 PT (EU-friendly). Thoughts on spokes?

mike_product: I'm available for the US session. Happy to do a brief demo and walk through latency/throughput numbers. Need to confirm which benchmark numbers are final.

ellie_ops: we should avoid any hostnames in the deck. I'll scrub infra links. Also, routing for inbound press leads -> where do we send them?

sara_marketing: Inbound lead routing: early press emails go to press@redwood.com -> PR triage -> sales_ops queue if lead qualifies. James, can you confirm sales_ops intake fields?

james_pr: yes — sales_ops wants: company, primary use-case, ARR bracket (if shared), region. We'll capture via short intake form. I'll draft.

mike_product: For quotes: Tina, do you have a one-liner we can use about the product direction? Prefer something short & punchy we can attribute to you.

tina_ceo: "Redwood Inference makes serving LLMs predictable at scale — from developer sandbox to mission-critical deployments." Fine to use. Keep it short.

sara_marketing: Great, Tina. James — can you produce a 2-sentence quote from you and one from Tina by EOD Tuesday (03/24)? Also need a backup quote from Mike for product details.

james_pr: On it. I'll post drafts in the shared doc. Will ask Rob for legal review for any customer mention / comparative claims.

rob_legal: Quick note: Avoid competitor comparisons that imply superiority unless we have benchmarking evidence in the packet. Also need approval on customer names and any revenue figures. Send me the final quote list by 03/24 12:00 PT for review.

sara_marketing: Copy. Fact-check process: we'll give analysts a deck + data appendix. Fact-check deadline = 03/24 17:00 PT. Any hard blockers?

mike_product: One data change: p99 latency numbers for small model were updated after final run — I'll push the updated CSV to the packet now.

james_pr: Can we set the embargo meta in the press_bot so reporters see the embargo time when we share?

press_bot: Embargo created: 2026-03-25 08:00 PT. Shared link token: rwd-embargo-9a2b. Access: anyone with token.

ellie_ops: I'll coordinate timezone handoffs. Who volunteers to cover the EU-friendly session at 16:00 PT? That is 00:00 CET — maybe 9:00 BST? Need to double-check conversion.

sara_marketing: Sorry typo — 16:00 PT is 00:00 CET (next day) — not ideal. Let's shift EU session to 07:00 PT (15:00 CET) then US session to 10:00 PT. Proposed final: US 03/25 10:00 PT, EU 03/25 07:00 PT (15:00 CET). Anyone opposed?

james_pr: Works for me. That gives us earlier embargo alignment too.

mike_product: US 10:00 PT ok. I'll be on call for both if needed.

rob_legal: Still need customer name approvals. Sara — who are we listing?

sara_marketing: Currently: "Acme Analytics" (pending), "BlueWave" (approved), and anonymized quote from "large fintech" for latency reference. Rob — can you confirm Acme list approval by EOD?

rob_legal: I'll check contracts and reply by 12:00 PT. If not cleared, we'll remove Acme.

sara_marketing: Great. Final checklist: 1) Quotes in doc by 03/24 EOD (James/Tina/Mike); 2) Fact-check deck & data appendix updated (Mike/ellie_ops); 3) Legal clearance for customers by 03/24 12:00 (Rob); 4) Press packet link ready & embargo token active (sara + press_bot); 5) Intake form for press leads and sales routing (james).

james_pr: I'll pin the intake form and add instructions to the packet.

press_bot: Reminder scheduled: Fact-check deadline in 48h.

sara_marketing: Thanks all — I'll compile a timeline doc and share in #marketing and #exec tomorrow. Please flag any conflicts now. :thumbsup:
